# files=15 commands=128

=== luo:math/chance ===
scoreboard players operation @s l6 = @s a0
scoreboard players operation @s l7 = @s a1
scoreboard players operation @s a0 = #1 cmcf.c
scoreboard players operation @s a1 = @s l6
function luo:math/rand
scoreboard players operation @s t3 = @s return
scoreboard players operation @s t3 -= @s l7
scoreboard players set @s t4 0
execute @s[score_t3=0] ~ ~ ~ scoreboard players set @s t4 1
scoreboard players operation @s return = @s t4
=== luo:math/comptime ===
scoreboard players set #math.1 math 1
scoreboard players set #math.2 math 2
scoreboard players set #math.4 math 4
scoreboard players set #math.100 math 100
scoreboard players set #math.1000 math 1000
scoreboard players set #math.2147483647 math 2147483647
scoreboard players set #math.-1 math -1

=== luo:math/lcg_next ===
scoreboard players operation @s a0 = seed math
function luo:math/lcg_step
scoreboard players operation @s l2 = @s return
scoreboard players operation @s t0 = seed math
scoreboard players operation @s t0 += #1234 cmcf.c
scoreboard players operation seed math = @s t0
scoreboard players operation @s return = @s l2
=== luo:math/lcg_step ===
scoreboard players operation @s return = #1103515245 cmcf.c
scoreboard players operation @s return *= @s a0
scoreboard players operation @s return += #1234 cmcf.c
scoreboard players operation @s return %= #67108864 cmcf.c
=== luo:math/load ===
scoreboard players set seed math 12345
=== luo:math/rand ===
scoreboard players operation @s l3 = @s a0
scoreboard players operation @s l4 = @s a1
scoreboard players operation @s l4 -= @s l3
scoreboard players operation @s l4 += #1 cmcf.c
function luo:math/lcg_next
scoreboard players operation @s l5 = @s return
scoreboard players operation @s return = @s l3
scoreboard players operation @s t1 = @s l5
scoreboard players operation @s t1 %= @s l4
scoreboard players operation @s t2 = @s t1
scoreboard players operation @s t2 += @s l4
scoreboard players operation @s t2 %= @s l4
scoreboard players operation @s return += @s t2
=== luo:math/sort_asc ===
scoreboard players set @s l13 0
scoreboard players set @s l14 64
execute @a[tag=math.sort] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sort_asc$b1
=== luo:math/sort_asc$b1 ===
scoreboard players operation @s t12 = #2147483647 cmcf.c
scoreboard players operation @s t12 < @a[tag=math.sort] math
scoreboard players operation @s l15 = @s t12
scoreboard players operation @a[tag=math.sort] temp1 = @s l15
scoreboard players operation @s l13 += #1 cmcf.c
scoreboard players remove @s l14 1
execute @a[tag=math.sort,score_l14_min=1] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sort_asc$b1
=== luo:math/sqrt ===
scoreboard players operation @s t5 = @s a0
scoreboard players operation @s t5 -= #4 cmcf.c
execute @s[score_t5=-1] ~ ~ ~ scoreboard players set @s return 1
execute @s[score_t5_min=0] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b2
=== luo:math/sqrt$b2 ===
scoreboard players operation @s l10 = @s a0
scoreboard players operation @s l10 /= #4 cmcf.c
scoreboard players set @s l11 0
scoreboard players set @s l12 32
scoreboard players operation @s t7 = @s l10
scoreboard players operation @s t7 -= @s l11
execute @s[score_t7=-1] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b3
execute @s[score_t7_min=1] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b3
execute @s[score_t7_min=0,score_t7=0] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b4
=== luo:math/sqrt$b3 ===
scoreboard players operation @s l11 = @s l10
scoreboard players operation @s t8 = @s a0
scoreboard players operation @s t8 /= @s l10
scoreboard players operation @s t9 = @s l10
scoreboard players operation @s t9 += @s t8
scoreboard players operation @s l10 = @s t9
scoreboard players operation @s l10 /= #2 cmcf.c
scoreboard players operation @s t11 = @s l10
scoreboard players operation @s t11 -= @s l11
scoreboard players remove @s l12 1
execute @s[score_l12_min=1,score_t11=-1] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b3
execute @s[score_l12_min=1,score_t11_min=1] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b3

execute @s[score_t11_min=0,score_t11=0] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b4
=== luo:math/sqrt$b4 ===
